title: [Master Data Management] Avoid duplicate excluded record insertion after match-based coupling
summary: Master Data Management's match-based coupling now handles records excluded by the local table filter correctly by logging an error instead of attempting duplicate creation, preventing misleading insertion failures.
key_points: Match-based coupling repeats lookups without the local filter when no match is found inside the filter, then logs an error pointing to the excluded record
The local table filter column on Synchronization Tables page is renamed to Local Table Filter and always visible
Fixed a latent bug where coupling crashed when source and local tables differed due to reading local field numbers from source records
Wildcard characters in text matching values are now properly escaped to prevent false matches when filter characters appear in source values
Added MatchExcludedByLocalTableFilter dimension to existing telemetry event 0000J8E to track excluded record scenarios
quote: If that finds a record, the source record is neither coupled nor queued for creation.
